traps.description: shipping-svc v5.2.0 went out 5 minutes before the failures, logs a carrier-selection warning, and a past incident blames a carrier release; but every failure is a 429 from parcelhub-api, and the errors return after the 12:27 rollback (which the first, partial deploys call hides)
Errors drop right after the rollback, which looks like the rollback fixed it; the dip follows a fall in quote traffic to 580/min, and errors climb back to 38% with v5.1.4 running
parcelhub-api's status page says all systems operational, which seems to clear the provider; a status page does not report a customer hitting its plan limit
